correctness.rationale: For every even N>=6, the indicator covariance entries independently reconstruct as c_N times the orthogonal projector onto the kernel of the complete graph unsigned incidence B. Schur complement and Sylvester yield the exact Gram determinant; Cauchy-Binet and odd-unicyclic incidence determinants yield all weights. Full rank iff every omitted-graph component contains an odd cycle. Rank and sharp volume maxima follow from component sizes, with factorial census from exhaustive 3-5 vertex component classification. The standalone checker passes 158 direct rational sample-Gram determinant tests plus all 5005 six-vertex omitted-edge patterns. Bounded checks supplement but do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: A natural, large homogeneous perfect-matching ensemble supports a first-degree harmonic Fourier band with substantial coordinate redundancy. The theorem classifies every coordinate-set information volume, provides a necessary and sufficient geometric injectivity test, solves the largest independent coordinate-design determinant exactly, and counts all designs with maximum volume for all even N>=6. Its infinite-family sharp quantification is not a textbook restatement of the known parent rank.
